metadata.name: exchange-price-node
metadata.description: Phase C.0 — exchange price supplied by a node reference rather than a constant. Equivalence fixture: with the price node held at 5.0 this must reproduce tests/fuzz_corpus/seed_exchange_node.json exactly. The scalar 'price' is set to a poison value of 999.0, so if price_node resolution fails the trajectory diverges obviously instead of subtly. The price node is declared AFTER the exchange node that reads it, exercising second-pass reference resolution.
